note: Invented changes in an invented ceramics studio. Nothing here is a real kiln, key or person.

routine.title: Move the cone 6 glazes to the dry shelf
routine.lede: Nine jars leave the mixing bench and go on shelf C. Nothing is in use.

steps.label: Label the jars with today’s date
steps.why: So the oldest is used first.

routine.undo: Move them back; the labels stay on.

consequential.title: Fire kiln 2 to cone 6
consequential.lede: It heats for about nine hours. The studio door must stay unlocked for the check at the peak.

steps.label: Check the vent and the shelves
Set the ramp
steps.to: 110 °C per hour, then 40 near the peak

undo.text: Stop the firing from the tray; the load stays in the kiln until it is cool.

hands.title: Waiting for you
hands.lede: The kiln needs your key before it lights.
hands.demo: This is a demonstration: it accepts any six digits, reads nothing and sends nothing.

destructive.title: Empty the slip tank
destructive.lede: About 140 litres of reclaimed slip go to the drain. It cannot be mixed again.

undo.text: The slip cannot be recovered once it has drained.

bulk.title: Retire 12 old glaze recipes
bulk.lede: They stop showing in the recipe list. Their test tiles stay.
bulk.undo: Restore them from the Retired tab.

failed.title: The firing stopped at 740 °C
failed.lede: The kiln cut the power by itself. The load is safe.

what.title: The vent fan did not answer
what.detail: The kiln checks the fan every minute and stopped after three misses.

todo: Wait until the kiln is below 100 °C before opening it.
Check the fan plug behind the kiln.
Start the firing again; it resumes from the shelf check.

undo.text: Nothing was fired fully, so there is nothing to undo.

success.title: The firing finished
success.lede: Kiln 2 reached cone 6 and has begun to cool.
success.undo: Nothing to undo. Open the kiln when it is below 100 °C.
